column1: # what the published per-grammar certification table was last RE-DERIVED against (GRAMMAR-CERT-STATUS.6).
# Written ONLY by: bash scripts/check_grammar_certification.sh --restamp   (tier 2 re-derives the table; this
# file is written when the published block equals the fresh derivation). Tier 1 reads it on every commit: an
# input whose sha256 still equals its row has not moved since that derivation; one that differs is counted
# against the staleness budget. The `block` row ties the attestation to the block it was made for.
